pages.text: $(thing)Effect Pages$() live in their own creative tab. Combine a potion-effect page with the rare $(thing)Age Effect$() page in your grammar to bind that effect to the Age. The selected effect is applied randomly, without particles, and it carries a high instability cost.

Age effects are separate from instability. Even a stable Age can keep its age effect. Use $(thing)/mystcraft age_effect toggle$() in the current Age to pause or resume it. If no age effect is written into the Age, the command does nothing.
